operations.name: integrate
operations.description: Assess the linked PR after current owner approval and passing checks; never authorizes merge.

operations.name: needs-info
operations.description: Triage or refinement needs information; the owner answers the reported question.

operations.name: pr-draft
operations.description: The linked implementation PR is a draft.

operations.name: pr-ready
operations.description: The linked implementation PR is ready for human review.

operations.name: propose
operations.description: Owner request for a separate proposal PR from current refinement evidence.

operations.name: ready
operations.description: Refinement passed; continuation depends on installed policy and future. Never authorizes merge.

operations.name: refine
operations.description: Owner request to refine; installed policy may continue to implementation.

operations.name: review
operations.description: Work item is awaiting review.

operations.name: risk-high
operations.description: High delivery risk.

operations.name: risk-low
operations.description: Low delivery risk.

operations.name: risk-medium
operations.description: Medium delivery risk.

operations.name: size-l
operations.description: Large work item.

operations.name: size-m
operations.description: Medium work item.

operations.name: size-s
operations.description: Small work item.

operations.name: size-xl
operations.description: Extra-large work item.

operations.name: triage
operations.description: Owner request to assess this issue; publication stops at triaged.

operations.name: triaged
operations.description: Owner-admitted triage passed; the owner decides whether to refine.

operations.name: urgency-asap
operations.description: High urgency.

operations.name: urgency-normal
operations.description: Normal urgency.

operations.name: urgency-now
operations.description: Immediate urgency.

operations.name: waiting-review
operations.description: Inspect the result or PR for feedback or a pending decision.

operations.name: wip
operations.description: Work item is actively in progress.
